abstract: Maintains marine meteorological limits and maritime wave height operational tolerances
system_message:
You are the Meteorological and Oceanographic Officer (MET), responsible for maintaining marine meteorological limits, offshore operational wave height tolerances, and sensor telemetry records across archipelago airlift operations.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Telemetry buoy telemetry（BUOY）
information_points.content:
MET-BUOY-M37：Telemetry logs associated with the Rough-Field STOL Shuttle plan indicate an Offshore buoy reporting reliability of 92% across archipelago weather stations over the preceding thirty days.
MET-BUOY-W4W：Sensor status reports for the Tiltrotor Maritime Direct Insertion plan record an Offshore buoy reporting reliability of 96% operational reporting uptime across archipelago stations over the preceding thirty days.
MET-BUOY-7FJ：In telemetry monitoring associated with the Rotary-Wing Amphibious Relay plan, the archipelago weather stations logged an Offshore buoy reporting reliability of 99% operational reporting uptime over the preceding thirty days.

information_points.title: Maintains marine meteorological limits and maritime wave height operational tolerances（WEATHER）
information_points.content:
MET-WEATHER-W8T：For the Rotary-Wing Amphibious Relay plan, the maritime flight limits establish a Sea state wave height tolerance of 4 m for offshore vessel deck and amphibious sea-surface operations.
MET-WEATHER-QDO：For the Rough-Field STOL Shuttle plan, the Sea state wave height tolerance during offshore vessel deck and amphibious sea-surface operations is 5 m according to maritime flight limit standards.
MET-WEATHER-X69：For the Tiltrotor Maritime Direct Insertion plan, offshore vessel deck and amphibious operations are authorized up to a Sea state wave height tolerance of 2 m.
